    <!-- MAIN CONTENT WRAPPER -->
    <div class="container content-wrap">

        <!-- INTRO -->
        <div class="intro-text">
            <h2>Interior Architect for Showroom Design for Attractive and Functional Spaces</h2>
            <p>More than just showing products, a showroom should be designed to give the customer a great shopping experience and help them find what they want. <b>Interior Architect for showroom design in Delhi</b> aids business establish not only great-looking but efficient showrooms that attract customers. The key areas to take into account while designing a showroom include product display, illumination, customer flow, furniture, coloring scheme, and branding of the business.</p>
            <p>Clothing shop design for a clothing showroom will be entirely different from a furniture showroom or an electronics showroom. As a showroom interior architect, we analyze the products to be sold, the amount of space, brand image, and business needs at the first stage. Finally, the design concept is based on a spacious showroom which is easy to access and welcoming.</p>
        </div>

        <!-- PHILOSOPHY / SERVICE OVERVIEW -->
        <div class="philosophy-box">
            <h2>Professional Showroom Interior Design for Easy Customer Movement and Display</h2>
            <p>As a showroom interior architect in Delhi, we believe a good showroom should be easy to understand and simple to use. The customer should never feel lost or clumsy when searching for a product.</p>
            <p>We map out the design in accordance with the area of the showroom, as well as the nature of goods that need to be sold. Shelves, cabinets, display units, counters, display cases, seating, lights, etc. are all placed with consideration. For those running a business, the need for a <b>professional showroom interior designer in Delhi</b> is high, and thorough planning is essential in order to make room for business functions as well as client comfort.</p>
        </div>

        <!-- SERVICE CATEGORIES GRID (4 CARDS) -->
        <div class="services-grid">
            
            <div class="service-card">
                <h3>Product Display & Lighting Planning</h3>
                <p>Product display is one of the most important parts of <b>showroom design</b>. Products should be placed where customers can see them easily. A showroom interior architect plans display units and shelves according to the type and size of the products, giving hero products prime positioning.</p>
                <p>The layout leaves plenty of room for customers to walk around comfortably. Clear movement paths make the shopping experience easier and more enjoyable.</p>
                <p>Good lighting transforms the entire look of a showroom. Different types of fixtures are used: focused display lights highlight merchandise, while ambient general lighting provides uniform brightness. Proper lighting planning ensures your products stand out.</p>
            </div>
            
            <div class="service-card">
                <h3>Brand-Based Showroom Design</h3>
                <p>A showroom should have a strong relation to the brand identity. An interior architect for showroom design coordinates the color tones of paint, wall finishes, furniture, signage, and exhibition stands following brand guidelines.</p>
                <p>When the entire showroom reflects the brand aesthetic, it becomes much easier for customers to recognize and remember your identity. Signature colors and distinctive architectural elements are introduced without cluttering the space.</p>
